description_en: Starts multiple data migration or synchronization tasks in a batch by calling the StartDtsJobs operation
description_zh: 调用StartDtsJobs接口批量启动数据迁移或同步任务
kebab_example: aliyun dts start-dts-jobs --dts-job-ids l5o11f9029c0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartDtsJobs

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the data migration or synchronization tasks.
Separate multiple task IDs with commas (,).
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to query DTS task IDs
parameters.help_zh:
迁移、同步任务ID。
当有多个任务ID时，使用','隔开。
可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html获取DTS任务ID
parameters.name: dts_job_ids

parameters.help_en: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: DTS实例所属的地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the node is a seamless integration (zero-ETL) node. Valid values:

false: No.
true: Yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否无感集成（Zero-ETL）任务，取值：

false：否。
true：是
parameters.name: zero_etl_job

DynamicCode.description_en: The dynamic error code. This parameter will be deprecated
DynamicCode.description_zh: 动态错误码，本参数即将下线

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace the %s variable in the ErrMessage response parameter.
For example, if ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, the request parameter DtsJobId is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的%s。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid.

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
